final_text: All 46 tests pass. The fix was in `visit_Constant` method in `sphinx/pycode/ast.py`: for numeric constants (int, float), I used `ast.get_source_segment(self.code, node)` to extract the original literal from the source code, preserving hex notation (`0x1234`) and underscores (`1_000_000`) instead of using `repr(node.value)` which would convert them to decimal.
